info.name: Wings of the Avariel
info.description: The construction for my custom Wings of the Avariel.
info.author: Gustavo Schip

description.p: Crafted from the wings of a Avariel, these delicate feathers still carry a trace of their innate magic. Though smaller than those of a normal Avariel, they can be worn and attuned to by a creature capable of bearing them.

While attuned to the wings, you have a pair of feathered wings that grant you a flying speed of 30 feet. Broad and delicate, they can span up to 8 feet when fully extended. Your flying speed is reduced to 25 feet while wearing light armor. You can't use this flying speed while wearing medium or heavy armor.
